important_limitation: Absence from historical marts does not prove absence from the historical airport dimension.
sql:
WITH historical_airports AS (
    SELECT airport_id FROM `tdb-dbt-bigquery-portfolio.dbt_dev.mart_airport_monthly_performance`
    WHERE airport_id IS NOT NULL

    UNION DISTINCT

    SELECT origin_airport_id AS airport_id FROM `tdb-dbt-bigquery-portfolio.dbt_dev.mart_route_monthly_performance`
    WHERE origin_airport_id IS NOT NULL

    UNION DISTINCT

    SELECT destination_airport_id AS airport_id FROM `tdb-dbt-bigquery-portfolio.dbt_dev.mart_route_monthly_performance`
    WHERE destination_airport_id IS NOT NULL
),
recent_usage AS (
    SELECT
        origin_airport_id AS airport_id,
        COUNT(*) AS origin_rows,
        0 AS destination_rows
    FROM `tdb-dbt-bigquery-portfolio.dbt_dev.fact_flights_2026_monthly_incremental`
    WHERE origin_airport_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY 1

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        destination_airport_id AS airport_id,
        0 AS origin_rows,
        COUNT(*) AS destination_rows
    FROM `tdb-dbt-bigquery-portfolio.dbt_dev.fact_flights_2026_monthly_incremental`
    WHERE destination_airport_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
    r.airport_id,
    SUM(r.origin_rows) AS origin_rows,
    SUM(r.destination_rows) AS destination_rows
FROM recent_usage r
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM historical_airports h
    WHERE h.airport_id = r.airport_id
)
GROUP BY r.airport_id
ORDER BY r.airport_id
